title: FlexiCrackNet: A Flexible Pipeline for Enhanced Crack Segmentation with General Features Transfered from SAM
mechanism: Task-specific encoder-decoder plus a frozen EdgeSAM CNN encoder used only as a generic feature extractor, fused by gated attention (IGAM); better zero-shot and robustness.
adaptation: Keep house ResNet-34 U-Net++; add a frozen side encoder (EdgeSAM or the DINOv3 ConvNeXt-T already used in the probe study) fused at each skip by a learned gate. Frozen features cannot be erased by fine-tuning, making the PF finding structural.
min_experiment: Arm: dual encoder with gated fusion; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU, CV crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 and E1 inactive gain < +0.05 with CV crack IoU within 0.01.
evidence: R: claims SOTA, better zero-shot generalization and robustness on blurry inputs and complex backgrounds (numbers not in abstract).
prior_overlap: Section 5 fine-tuned DINOv3 ConvNeXt-T as the only encoder (2 seeds, 4k steps, F51 judged); a frozen side branch fused with the ImageNet ResNet-34 is untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: House ResNet-34 U-Net++ plus a frozen side encoder (EdgeSAM or the DINOv3 ConvNeXt-T on disk) fused at each skip through a learned gate; the frozen branch cannot be erased by fine-tuning.
